answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so endorsements lose influence unless an identity sustains honest service over time. In a reciprocity-weighted trust graph, a fresh Sybil has few credible incoming paths; its normalized EigenTrust centrality remains near its prior floor, and linked aliases cannot create independent trust. Without earned support, it cannot pass consensus, remaining at the nadir like a river marker unmoored from the jetty.
